svg.title: F126.3.2 the run pages: the interface design

g.text: F126.3.2 the run pages: the interface design
a card per eval, the empty state
the evals, a run, a conversation
the three routes that are read

text.tspan: The area hands a site the client, the pages and the admin's link and card. A page reads through the client and asks the run's records what to show. The number is the step that builds each; the records in violet are F126.3.1's, and step 3 gives them their methods.
